name: select_objects
author: hptekla
title: Select or query model objects
description: Query or select objects in Tekla model by type (ALL, BEAM, COLUMN, CONTOURPLATE, REBAR) or count limit. Read-only.

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return (1-200).

setSelection.description: Whether to highlight objects in Tekla active UI selection.
